comparison.objective: Empty a vacuum dust cup through its bottom flap into a bin and click the cup back in; body and specs are empty.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a flap, control particulate discharge, and re-latch the cup; spill and latch thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.success_condition: Contents deposited in the bin and cup clicked back in; allowed residue/spill and latch verification are missing.
comparison.reason: Emptying and re-latching a container tests discharge control, not dynamic mechanical tuning and setting retention.
